payout_quote: To qualify for $300 offer, account holder must set up and make a $1,000 direct deposit for 3 consecutive months and sign-up for eStatements from the date the account was opened. Account must remain open for six months. $300 will be deposited after checking account has been open for 6 months and met all requirements. Offer valid to individuals with no prior checking relationship with TopLine Financial Credit Union in the last 12 months. $50 minimum deposit required to open Totally Free Checking account. Qualifying direct deposits are electronic deposits of regular periodic payments (such as salary, pension, social security, or other regular monthly income) deposited through the Automated Clearing House (ACH) network to this account by your employer or an outside agency. Promotional credit will be reported as income on the account holders 1099-MISC. If all requirements are not met, TopLine reserves the right to reclaim the $300. Offer valid through 12/31/26. Membership with a $5.00 Share Savings Account is required.
steps: Confirm TopLine Financial Credit Union membership eligibility (16 Minnesota counties, select employer groups, or immediate family of existing members).
Open a Totally Free Checking account ($50 minimum deposit) plus the required $5.00 Share Savings membership share.
Open a new TopLine Financial checking account (no promo code is stated in the official terms).
Set up direct deposits totaling $1,000 or more per month for 3 consecutive months and enroll in eStatements.
Keep the account open for six months; the $300 is deposited to the share savings account about four weeks after all requirements are met.
catches: Requires $1,000+ direct deposit for THREE consecutive months - high threshold.
Account must remain open for six months - money committed long term.
Bonus paid only after the account has been open 6 months, plus up to four more weeks - very slow payout (~7 months).
Not eligible if you had a TopLine checking relationship in the last 12 months.
TopLine reserves the right to reclaim the $300 if requirements are not met.
Membership limited to Minnesota counties / employer groups.
Qualifying DD excludes transfers, PayPal/Venmo/Zelle, mobile and branch/ATM deposits.
Bonus reported on 1099-MISC as taxable income.
No promo code is stated in the official terms; any code cited by third-party sites could not be confirmed officially and is not required per the provider page.
biggest_catch: $1,000+/month in direct deposits for three consecutive months AND a six-month account open requirement before the $300 is paid - this is a seven-month commitment.
eligibility: New TopLine checking customers (no checking relationship in last 12 months) in eligible Minnesota counties/employer groups; membership with a $5 share savings account required.
timing: $300 deposited to the share savings account after the checking account has been open 6 months and all requirements met (allow up to four weeks after requirements).
